dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent elliptical and sub-circular 'O' shapes with jagged, high-intensity light-colored perimeters; the gradient transitions from a dark exterior base coat to a bright, stippled ring boundary, enclosing dark interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of bright pixel clusters forming the boundaries of macro-annuli, with scattered individual high-intensity speckles localized on the upper-right dorsal section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most distinct posterior-lateral rings form an irregular quadrilateral, with the most elongated axis oriented parallel to the spinal column.
